fusions.name: Wrung Dry
fusions.desc: A crushing grip that deals 16 damage and draws out every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one drawn. It leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Snatching Reach
fusions.desc: Grabs at a target up to 5 tiles away, which deals 4 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach, slows it by 20% for 2 seconds and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Locked Grip
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 10 seconds and restores 6 health.

fusions.name: Hold Fast and Feed
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
